publisher: דגל התורה (עותק באירוח המכון הישראלי לדמוקרטיה)
evidence: The leaflet scanned inside the file (sha256 9247e6bd3c0de137d3eac58577d97b8d14654cfc05ab31487da3d9dea2a4ae9d) is the standalone platform of אגודת החרדים – דגל התורה: headings 'מצע המפלגה' and 'הצבע עץ', ballot box עץ. The official 1988 results and candidate gazettes list 'אגודת החרדים – דגל התורה' under the letters עץ (12-עץ). In 1992 Degel HaTorah ran inside the joint list ג (יהדות התורה) and no 1992 list had the letters עץ, so the leaflet is not the 1992 joint-list platform. Hebrew Wikipedia (secondary, revision 44114316): 1988 was the only election Degel HaTorah contested on its own.
